```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Rendered by generate_report() in an environment whose parent is the monolixPipelineR
# namespace, so package helpers (report_groups(), read_shrinkage(), ...) and its imports
# (dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, ...) are available. Monolix must be initialized (init_monolix()).
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(gt)
library(GGally)
library(lixoftConnectors)
# Monolix's own plots (plotVpc(), ...) use the global theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(),
                  panel.grid.minor = element_line(),
                  strip.background = element_blank()))
# The report's own plots use the package's theme_report() (groups coloured with Dark2)

# Show a Monolix plot or table, or a note when it isn't available for this project
# (e.g. no censored data for the BLQ check), instead of failing the whole report
show_or_note <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) cat("Not available for this project:", conditionMessage(e), "\n"))
}
gt_signif <- function(df, digits = 2) gt(mutate(df, across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, digits))))
```

# Project Details
## Project Setup {.tabset}

```{r}
loaded <- loadProject(projectFile = params$project)
if (isFALSE(loaded)) stop("Monolix could not load ", params$project)
stat_tests <- getTests()
methods <- result_methods(getScenario()$linearization)
indiv_model <- getIndividualParameterModel()
data_info <- getData()
stratify_by <- unlist(params$stratify_by)
```

**Project file:** `r params$project`

**Dataset:** `r data_info$dataFile`

**Model:** `r getStructuralModel()`

**Standard errors from:** `r methods$se`; **likelihood from:** `r methods$ll`

**Report groups:** `r if (length(stratify_by)) paste(stratify_by, collapse = ", ") else "none (report.stratify_by not set)"`

### Parameter Distributions and Random Effects

```{r}
specs <- data.frame(parameter = names(indiv_model$distribution),
                    Distribution = unname(indiv_model$distribution),
                    IIV = unname(indiv_model$variability$id[names(indiv_model$distribution)]))
cov_model <- indiv_model$covariateModel
if (length(cov_model) && length(cov_model[[1]])) {
  cov_table <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, cov_model[specs$parameter]))
  specs <- cbind(specs, cov_table)
}
check_cols <- setdiff(names(specs), c("parameter", "Distribution"))
table <- specs %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(check_cols), ~ ifelse(.x, "check", ""))) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "parameter")
if (length(check_cols) > 1) table <- table %>% tab_spanner(label = "Covariates", columns = check_cols[-1])
for (k in check_cols) {
  table <- table %>% fmt_icon(columns = all_of(k), rows = !!sym(k) == "check")
}
table
```

# Predictions

```{r}
# Data, predictions and report groups. The observation column of predictions.txt is the one
# column that isn't id, time or a prediction (see observation_column()).
id_column <- data_info$header[data_info$headerTypes == "id"]
data <- read_monolix_data(data_info$dataFile)
predictions_file <- file.path(sub("\\.mlxtran$", "", params$project), "predictions.txt")
predictions <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(read_csv(predictions_file, show_col_types = FALSE)),
                        error = function(e) NULL)
obs <- if (!is.null(predictions)) tryCatch(observation_column(predictions), error = function(e) NULL)
groups <- tryCatch(report_groups(data, id_column, stratify_by, params$group_labels),
                   error = function(e) { cat("Report groups not used:", conditionMessage(e), "\n");
                     report_groups(data, id_column) })
if (!is.null(predictions)) {
  # predictions.txt calls the id column "id" or uses the data's id header
  pred_id <- intersect(c("id", id_column), names(predictions))[1]
  predictions <- merge(predictions, groups, by.x = pred_id, by.y = "id")
  names(predictions)[names(predictions) == pred_id] <- "id"
}
if (is.null(predictions)) cat("No predictions.txt in the results folder; the conditional_mode task may not have run.\n")
if (!is.null(predictions) && is.null(obs)) {
  cat("Can't tell the observation column apart in predictions.txt (several observations?); prediction plots skipped.\n")
}
can_plot <- !is.null(predictions) && !is.null(obs)

# Fine-grained curves (Monolix's individual fits chart data, on the `grid` time points).
# Computed here when the results folder doesn't have them yet.
results_dir <- sub("\\.mlxtran$", "", params$project)
fits <- if (can_plot) read_indfits(results_dir, obs)
if (can_plot && is.null(fits)) {
  show_or_note(computeChartsData(plot = "indfits", output = obs))
  fits <- read_indfits(results_dir, obs)
}
if (!is.null(fits)) {
  ind_col <- attr(fits, "indiv_column")
  fits <- merge(fits, groups, by = "id")
  attr(fits, "indiv_column") <- ind_col
} else if (can_plot) {
  cat("No individual fits chart data (ChartsData/IndividualFits); predictions are drawn at the observation times only.\n")
  ind_col <- intersect(c("indivPred_mode", "indivPred_mean"), names(predictions))[1]
  fits <- data.frame(id = predictions$id, time = predictions$time, popPred = predictions$popPred,
                     indivPred = predictions[[ind_col]], group = predictions$group)
  attr(fits, "indiv_column") <- ind_col
}

# Group colours: Dark2 up to 8 groups, ggplot2's default hues beyond that
n_groups <- nlevels(groups$group)
group_colors <- if (n_groups <= 8) scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") else NULL
if (n_groups > 8) cat("More than 8 report groups; default colors used.\n")
```

## Population trends for each group

```{r}
if (can_plot) {
  fits %>%
    ggplot(aes(time, popPred, color = group)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = id), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
    group_colors +
    labs(x = "Time", y = obs, color = "Group", title = "Population predictions for each group") +
    theme_report()
}
```

## Predictions for each individual

```{r}
if (can_plot) {
  ggplot(fits, aes(time, indivPred, color = group, group = id)) +
    geom_point(data = predictions, aes(time, .data[[obs]]), alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~group) +
    group_colors +
    labs(x = "Time", y = obs, color = "Group",
         title = paste0("Individual predictions (", attr(fits, "indiv_column"), ")")) +
    theme_report()
}
```


## Model variables for each individual

```{r}
# Model variables simulated with Simulx by generate_report() on a fine grid; otherwise the
# model's `table = {...}` variables at the observation times (tables.txt)
model_vars <- read_simulated_variables(results_dir)
vars_subtitle <- "Simulated with Simulx from each individual's estimates"
if (is.null(model_vars)) {
  model_vars <- read_model_variables(results_dir)
  vars_subtitle <- "At the observation times (tables.txt): no Simulx simulation for this report"
}
vars_prediction <- attr(model_vars, "prediction")
if (!is.null(model_vars)) model_vars <- merge(model_vars, groups, by = "id")
if (is.null(model_vars) || !nrow(model_vars)) {
  cat("No model variables in tables.txt (add `table = {...}` to the model's OUTPUT section).\n")
}
vars_fig_height <- if (is.null(model_vars)) 3 else 1 + 1.8 * nlevels(model_vars$variable)
```

```{r, fig.height = vars_fig_height, fig.width = max(6, 1 + 2.5 * n_groups)}
if (!is.null(model_vars) && nrow(model_vars)) {
  ggplot(model_vars, aes(time, value, color = group, group = id)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(variable ~ group, scales = "free_y") +
    group_colors +
    labs(x = "Time", y = NULL,
         title = paste0("Individual predictions of the model variables (", vars_prediction, ")"),
         subtitle = vars_subtitle) +
    theme_report() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```


# Results

## Population parameter estimates {.tabset}

```{r}
# Estimates (with CVs), standard errors and confidence intervals
estimates <- getEstimatedPopulationParameters(coefficientsOfVariation = TRUE, withValuesByGroups = TRUE)
if (is.list(estimates)) {
  estimates[grepl("Infinity", estimates)] <- Inf
  estimates <- unlist(estimates)
}
estimates <- data.frame(parameter = names(estimates), estimate = unname(as.numeric(estimates)))

ses <- getEstimatedStandardErrors(withValuesByGroups = TRUE)[[methods$se]]
cis <- tryCatch(getEstimatedConfidenceIntervals(withValuesByGroups = TRUE)[[methods$se]], error = function(e) NULL)
all_parameters <- estimates
if (!is.null(ses)) all_parameters <- merge(all_parameters, ses, by = "parameter", all.x = TRUE)
if (!is.null(cis)) all_parameters <- merge(all_parameters, cis, by = "parameter", all.x = TRUE)
has_ci <- all(c("P2.5", "P97.5") %in% names(all_parameters))

is_pop <- grepl("_pop$", all_parameters$parameter)
is_beta <- grepl("^beta_", all_parameters$parameter)
is_cv <- grepl("_CV$", all_parameters$parameter)
is_omega <- grepl("^omega", all_parameters$parameter) & !is_cv
is_err <- is_error_param_name(all_parameters$parameter)
```

### Population parameters
```{r}
pop <- transform_estimates(all_parameters[is_pop, ], params$report_transforms)
if (length(params$report_transforms)) {
  pop <- pop %>% select(reported_parameter, starts_with("reported_"), everything())
} else {
  pop <- pop %>% select(-starts_with("reported_"))
}
gt_signif(pop)
```

### Treatment Effects
Covariate effects (`beta_`). For log-normally distributed parameters, `exp(estimate)` is the fold change in the parameter.
```{r}
tab <- all_parameters[is_beta, ]
if (nrow(tab)) {
  tab <- tab %>% mutate(fold_change = exp(estimate))
  if (has_ci) tab <- tab %>% mutate(fc_P2.5 = exp(P2.5), fc_P97.5 = exp(P97.5))
  tab %>% select(parameter, estimate, fold_change, everything()) %>% gt_signif()
} else {
  cat("No covariate effects in the model.\n")
}
```

### Population parameters by group
```{r}
tab <- all_parameters[!(is_pop | is_beta | is_omega | is_err | is_cv), ]
if (nrow(tab)) gt_signif(tab) else cat("No values by group.\n")
```

### Standard deviations of random effects
```{r}
cv <- all_parameters[is_cv, c("parameter", "estimate")] %>%
  transmute(parameter = sub("_CV$", "", parameter), CV = estimate)
tab <- merge(all_parameters[is_omega, ], cv, by = "parameter", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(fold_change = exp(estimate))
if (has_ci) tab <- tab %>% mutate(fc_P2.5 = exp(P2.5), fc_P97.5 = exp(P97.5))
tab %>% select(parameter, fold_change, estimate, CV, everything()) %>% gt_signif()
```

### Correlation of Estimates
```{r, out.width="100%", out.height="100%", warning=TRUE}
FIM <- tryCatch(getCorrelationOfEstimates()[[methods$se]], error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(FIM)) {
  cn <- condition_number_of(FIM)
  if (!is.na(cn)) cat("Condition number:", formatC(cn, format = "e", digits = 1), "\n")
  as.data.frame(as.matrix(FIM)) %>% rownames_to_column("parameter1") %>%
    pivot_longer(!parameter1, names_to = "parameter2") %>%
    mutate(across(c(parameter1, parameter2), ~ factor(.x, levels = rownames(as.matrix(FIM))))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(parameter1, parameter2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(data = . %>% filter(abs(value) > 0.5), aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 1.7) +
    labs(fill = "correlation", x = "", y = "") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", limits = c(-1.1, 1.1)) +
    theme_report() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
} else {
  cat("Standard errors not estimated.\n")
}
```

### Correlation of individual parameters
```{r, out.width="100%", out.height="100%"}
# Pairs of individual parameters (or of their random effects, prefix "eta_"); the tables
# also have id, rep and the covariates, which are left out
pairs_plot <- function(df, prefix = "") {
  cols <- intersect(paste0(prefix, names(indiv_model$distribution)), names(df))
  ggpairs(df, columns = cols, progress = FALSE,
          diag = list(continuous = function(data, mapping) ggplot(data, mapping) + geom_histogram(fill = "black", bins = 30))) +
    theme_report()
}
show_or_note(pairs_plot(getSimulatedIndividualParameters()))
```

Test if random effects are correlated using a t-test
```{r}
if (!is.null(stat_tests$randomEffectsCorrelation)) {
  stat_tests$randomEffectsCorrelation %>%
    mutate(value = paste0(signif(statistics, 2), " (", format(signif(p.value, 3), scientific = TRUE), ")")) %>%
    select(eta1, eta2, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = eta1, values_fill = "") %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "eta2") %>%
    tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold", stub.font.weight = "bold") %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = "random effect") %>%
    tab_spanner(everything(), label = "Random Effect") %>%
    tab_footnote(footnote = "Numbers in parentheses are p-values from a t-test.",
                 locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything()))
} else {
  cat("Not available (no Monolix tests for this project).\n")
}
```

### Parameters vs Covariates

Test for correlation of parameters and covariates with a t-test and the Wald test
```{r}
p_style <- function(tab, column) {
  tab %>% tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "red"),
                    locations = cells_body(columns = all_of(column), rows = .data[[column]] > 0.05))
}
wald <- stat_tests$wald
ttest <- stat_tests$indivParamsCorrelation
if (!is.null(wald) && !is.null(ttest)) {
  merge(ttest, wald %>% rename(covariate = parameter), by = "covariate") %>%
    select(parameter, covariate, statistics.x, p.value.x, statistics.y, p.value.y) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
    group_by(parameter) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "covariate") %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "T-Test", columns = ends_with("x")) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "Wald Test", columns = ends_with("y")) %>%
    cols_label(p.value.x = "p-value", p.value.y = "p-value", statistics.x = "statistic", statistics.y = "statistic") %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = "Covariate") %>%
    p_style("p.value.y")
} else if (!is.null(wald)) {
  wald %>% rename(covariate = parameter) %>% select(-any_of("method")) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "covariate") %>%
    cols_label(p.value = "p-value", statistics = "statistic") %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = "Covariate") %>%
    p_style("p.value")
} else if (!is.null(ttest)) {
  ttest %>% select(parameter, covariate, statistics, p.value) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
    group_by(parameter) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "covariate") %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "T-Test", columns = c("statistics", "p.value")) %>%
    cols_label(p.value = "p-value", statistics = "statistic") %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = "Covariate")
} else {
  cat("No covariates.\n")
}
```

Test whether covariates should be added to the model using Pearson's correlation test and/or ANOVA

```{r}
if (!is.null(stat_tests$randomEffectsVsCovariatesCorrelation)) {
  stat_tests$randomEffectsVsCovariatesCorrelation %>%
    mutate(value = paste0(signif(statistics, 2), " (", format(signif(p.value, 3), scientific = TRUE), ")")) %>%
    select(eta, covariate, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = covariate) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = "eta") %>%
    tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold", stub.font.weight = "bold") %>%
    tab_stubhead(label = "Random Effect") %>%
    tab_spanner(everything(), label = "Covariate Correlation") %>%
    tab_footnote(footnote = "Numbers in parentheses are p-values.",
                 locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything()))
} else {
  cat("No covariates.\n")
}
```
